_why: Figure 10.2 'Signs' (PDF idx 125, printed p116) prints three hazard placards whose wording is drawn inside the artwork, so PyMuPDF cannot see it: the words FLAMMABLE, LIQUID, GAS and EXPLOSIVES occur ZERO times in the whole chapter's text layer while the figure plainly prints all three placards. Verified on the rendered page at 8x magnification: a red diamond reading FLAMMABLE LIQUID with the digit 3 below it, a red diamond reading FLAMMABLE GAS with the digit 2, and an orange diamond reading EXPLOSIVES with the digit 1. Exercise Q8's answer cites these three labels because they are the only symbol meanings the chapter prints anywhere, and the nine unlabelled pictograms of Q8 itself carry no text at all. Transcribed off the render and attributed to the figure they come from, so that a genuine invention still stands out from a figure-only label.
